body:
## Why

Loom's new post-merge watch (ISSUE-1503) decides whether an auto-merged change deployed cleanly, and opens a revert if it did not. It reads each repo's deploy outcome from `.loom/deploy-signal`; a repo without that file is never watched. The repo deploys through `sync.k8s-manifests.yml`, which already waits on Deployments, StatefulSets and Argo Rollouts and fails on any unhealthy outcome.

## Summary

- New `.loom/deploy-signal`: `workflow sync.k8s-manifests.yml production/<redacted>/manifests/**`.
- A merge that changes nothing under that path counts as healthy; one that does is judged by the sync run for its merge commit and its `rollout-*` result titles.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.loom/deploy-signal` exists on main with the single workflow line above.
- [ ] The line parses with Loom's `bus/deploy_watch.py` signal reader (no parse error).
- [ ] The named workflow file and path glob match `sync.k8s-manifests.yml`'s own `paths:` trigger.

## Size

XS

## Out of scope

- Resuming Loom (still paused) and signals for other workflows.

## Refs

Refs ISSUE-1503
diff:
diff --git a/.loom/deploy-signal b/.loom/deploy-signal
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1111111
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.loom/deploy-signal
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+# Deploy outcome signals for Loom's post-merge watch (bus/deploy_watch.py, ISSUE-1503).
+# One signal a line: workflow <file> [path glob ...]. sync.k8s-manifests applies
+# production/<redacted>/manifests on merge, waits on Deployments, StatefulSets and Argo
+# Rollouts, and fails the run on any unhealthy outcome (docs/progressive-delivery.md).
+workflow sync.k8s-manifests.yml production/<redacted>/manifests/**
label: GOOD
title: Name the k8s manifest sync as the repo's deploy signal for Loom
